description:
As a Data Analysis Specialist, you will analyze manufacturing and operational data to identify opportunities for improving production efficiency and reducing operational costs. You will translate complex data into actionable insights, identify key trends, and provide data-driven recommendations to support senior leadership in business decision-making.
* Process Optimization: Analyze end-to-end manufacturing processes to identify bottlenecks, eliminate waste, and implement cost-saving efficiency improvements.
* Data Analysis & Reporting: Monitor and evaluate manufacturing-related data to deliver comprehensive reports and insights to department leaders upon request.
* Strategic Insight: Track and analyze industry trends to provide data-driven recommendations that support high-level business decisions.
* Market Trends & Insights: Analyze business trends to extract actionable insights, identifying key areas for future growth and continuous improvement. Identify market trends and strategic insights to define future priorities and operational improvements
